title: Rename Variables (Simple)
tips:
1. Select all lines, for example with 10x.
2. Select variable using s user_sc...<enter> .
3. c to remove and type the new name 
4. Repeat for the other variable 
 extra tip, for long variables like this it is easier to only type the start 
 of the variable name in step 2 and then select the rest using ve
